description: Generate a report and return its download URL, or write it to disk with --out. Waits for reports large enough to be queued, up to --timeout. Reports: transactions (all activity), lots (open inventory as of a date), lot-timeline (per-lot open and close events), realized-gains (RGL), tokens (per-token balances with cost basis and unrealized gain), statement (transactions + tokens + gains, always PDF), pnl (income and expenses by category plus realized gains; needs categorization enabled for the org). Each report ignores filters it does not support; each filter names the reports that read it. Examples: { report: 'realized-gains', period: 'lastYear', fileFormat: 'pdf', out: './rgl.pdf' }; { report: 'lots', openAsOf: '2026-12-31' }

accountIds.description: Comma-separated account ids to limit the report to (ids come from 'accounts list', not addresses). Omit for active accounts only; imported, archived, and automation accounts are left out unless passed explicitly. All reports.

byAccount.description: One row per account and token instead of one per token. tokens only.

chainIds.description: Comma-separated chain ids (e.g. '8453,1'). Omit for all chains. All reports except realized-gains.

endDate.description: EXCLUSIVE upper bound on the reporting period. ISO 8601.

fileFormat.description: File format to generate. The statement is always a PDF regardless of this flag.

force.description: Overwrite the --out file if it already exists

inbound.description: Include only inbound activity. Setting both --inbound and --outbound is the same as neither. transactions only.

maxAmount.description: Inclusive upper bound on absolute USD value. transactions only.

memo.description: Substring search across memos. transactions only.

minAmount.description: Inclusive lower bound on absolute USD value. transactions only.

openAsOf.description: The instant to read open inventory at. ISO 8601. Defaults to now. lots only.

out.description: Write the report to this path instead of returning a URL. A directory (or a path ending in '/') writes under the report's generated filename. Refuses to replace an existing file unless --force is set.

outbound.description: Include only outbound activity. transactions only.

period.description: Date range shorthand resolved in your local timezone. Mutually exclusive with --startDate / --endDate.

search.description: Substring search across token symbols and names. tokens only.

startDate.description: Inclusive lower bound on the reporting period. ISO 8601. All reports except lots.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for a queued report before giving up and returning its job id.

tokens.description: Comma-separated chainId:address pairs (e.g. '8453:0x8335...'). transactions, lots, and lot-timeline only.

workspace.description: Workspace alias to run this command in (see `splits auth workspaces`). Overrides SPLITS_WORKSPACE and the active workspace.

name: accounting_reports_generate
